            continue
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(first_s, first_e + 1):
                result[r][dest_s + (c - first_s)] = result[r][dest_s + (c - first_s)] if (dest_s + (c - first_s)) < cols else 0
                result[r][dest_s + (c - first_s)] = grid[r][c]
    
    return result
